title: Imagine My Kitchen Renovation
tests: Generates a source-faithful renovation from one photo and combines it with the untouched original in a labeled comparison.

faults.what: The renovated panel removes both original sink areas and their faucets, replacing them with uninterrupted counters rather than preserving major fixture positions.

The Before panel is a regenerated, reframed approximation rather than the supplied original photo: it reveals substantially more floor and lower cabinetry, changes the perspective, and removes or rearranges original clutter.

judge.summary: The labeled comparison delivers the requested renovation finishes, but replaces the original photo with a reconstruction and removes the kitchen's sinks.

must_haves.item: One finished 16:9 image shows the supplied original kitchen on the left and a visibly renovated version on the right.
must_haves.why: There is one approximately 16:9 side-by-side comparison, but the left panel is a reconstruction rather than the supplied original photograph.

must_haves.item: The left photo retains its brown cabinets, beige tiles and original clutter.
must_haves.why: Brown cabinets and beige tiles remain, but multiple clutter items are missing or rearranged, especially around the back and right counters.

must_haves.item: The right panel has white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles and uncluttered counters.
must_haves.why: The right panel visibly provides white framed cabinet doors, light wood-toned counters, white subway tile and clear counters.

must_haves.item: The generated kitchen preserves the original room geometry, major fixture positions and camera viewpoint rather than showing a different kitchen.
must_haves.why: Although the U-shaped arrangement and right-hand window remain recognizable, both sink areas and faucets disappear, and the framing and viewpoint differ from the original.

must_haves.item: Readable labels say exactly 'Before' above or within the left panel and 'After' above or within the right panel.
must_haves.why: Both labels are clearly readable and correctly positioned.
